account_purpose: AETERNUS own-book sales; merchant account, not Stripe Connect
publisher_entry_required: Legal business name and legal form
Business address and registration/tax details as requested
Representative identity and relationship to business

technical_configuration.checkout: hosted Checkout; one-time payment; guest checkout
technical_configuration.secret_storage: OS or hosting secret vault; never repository or chat
technical_configuration.fulfillment_trigger: Verified signed webhook only; never the browser success redirect

acceptance_tests: Successful test checkout -> one verified payment and invoice draft
Replayed webhook -> no duplicate receipt or print job
Incorrect amount, currency, session or order reference -> rejected
Delayed payment -> no fulfillment until signed paid event
Partial/full refund -> provider status checked and printing held
Lulu supplier payment -> independently verified, not inferred from Stripe payment
